title: SurveyScheduledPayload
description: SYNTHETIC: surveys - no Masa equivalent; legacy oracle in legacy-fixtures/

cfUuid.title: CfUuid
cfUuid.description: ColdFusion createUUID() id: 35 uppercase hex characters grouped 8-4-4-16.

SurveyScheduledReminder.title: SurveyScheduledReminder
SurveyScheduledReminder.description: One reminder task of the schedule.

n.description: Reminder ordinal, 1-based in request order; the taskName suffix.

offsetMinutes.description: Minutes after launchAt; the legacy fixture rejects negative offsets.

taskName.description: Reminder task name on queue communications-reminders; at most 100 characters, as synthetic.survey_reminder.task_name.

SurveyScheduledTarget.title: SurveyScheduledTarget
SurveyScheduledTarget.description: A targeted site, optionally narrowed to one group.

groupName.description: Group name within the site, as tusers.GroupName; null targets every user of the site.

siteId.description: Legacy site id owning the survey, for example tenant-a; never a tenant UUID.

scheduleVersion.description: Schedule version: 1 when first scheduled, incremented on each reschedule.

launchAt.description: Launch time in the legacy server's local time zone, with milliseconds and no offset.

launchTaskName.description: Launch task name on queue surveys-launch.

reminders.description: Reminder tasks in ordinal order; empty when none are scheduled.

targets.description: Sites and groups the survey targets; empty when none are set.
